rows.en: ＊Tomoe＊＠１８０＿０２２Just hurry!￥I have a bad... a really￥bad feeling!!
＊Tomoe＊＠１８０＿０２３Even if it turns out I'm just￥imagining things...
＊＊－　Medical Room　－＝－　You must have passed out...　－
＊＊－　Medical Room　－＝－　Looks like you passed out...　－
＊Sakaki＊＠１８１＿００３Hm? Could it be...＝＠１８１＿００４you don't remember￥what happened...?

＊Sakaki＊＠１８１＿００６The straps on the materials in￥the Maintenance Room wore out,￥and the steel beams came down.＝＠１８１＿００７I never dreamed this could￥happen... We supervisors are￥fully to blame. I'm truly sorry.＝＠１８１＿００９One wrong move, and we could￥have lost two precious￥candidates...
＊Sakaki＊＠１８１＿０１０The one saving grace is that￥neither you nor Tomoe￥was hurt.
＊Sakaki＊＠１８１＿０１２Anyway, I'm glad you're￥both safe...＝＠１８１＿０１３You should make sure to thank￥Tomoe properly later.

＊Sakaki＊＠１８１＿０１５She was looking after you until￥just now, but she seems to have￥worn herself out...＝＠１８１＿０１６Still, I'm relieved. Until now,￥she seemed to see nothing but￥her own problems...＝＠１８１＿０１７Caring for and helping others...￥it's a sign she's starting to￥see the people around her.＝＠１８１＿０１８Could it be...￥that you've rubbed off on her?
＊Sakaki＊＠１８１＿０２０When she wakes up,￥walk her back, all right?＝＠１８１＿０２１I'm going to check on the￥Maintenance Room.
＊Sakaki＊＠１８１＿０２２We have to make sure this never￥happens again... I'm so sorry.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８１＿０２４Oh... thank goodness...￥Are you feeling all right now?
＊Tomoe＊＠１８１＿０２５When I shoved you out of the￥way, um... you hit your head on￥the wall...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８１＿０２６So it's my fault you were￥knocked out... I'm sorry.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８１＿０２７Oh, no, it's nothing...＝＠１８１＿０２８But I was surprised. I didn't￥know even I could do something￥like that on the spot...
＊Tomoe＊＠１８１＿０２９Oh, I'm fine.＝＠１８１＿０３０Sakaki already checked me￥over, and I actually feel￥pretty good...

＊Tomoe＊＠１８２＿００３Honestly, I'm still scared to￥tell people about my power.＝＠１８２＿００４Being able to sense the￥future... of course people find￥it creepy.＝...＝＠１８２＿００５But I knew you might be in￥danger, and I couldn't just stay￥quiet.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８２＿００８I'm glad my power could be￥of some use to you.
＊Tomoe＊＠１８２＿００９For the first time... I think I￥might be able to like my own￥power...
